result.summary: This residential intersection is identified as a school zone by signage, yet it lacks clear, high-visibility pedestrian infrastructure. While sidewalks are present, the pavement markings are severely faded and there are no physical traffic calming measures to protect vulnerable road users.

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: The school crossing and stop bar markings are nearly invisible, failing to provide a clear visual cue for drivers to expect pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface in the foreground and center

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right curb near the intersection can hide pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to significantly improve the visibility of the pedestrian crossing area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct sidewalk extensions at the corners to reduce crossing distance, improve sight lines, and prevent illegal parking near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to ensure clear sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: This residential intersection features sidewalks on both sides but lacks any marked pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The wide, unmarked roadway and presence of parked cars near the corners create potential visibility and safety issues for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, providing no designated space for pedestrians and no visual cue for drivers to expect them.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style pavement markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: A residential street with sidewalks on both sides and a faded marked crosswalk at the intersection. The environment is generally walkable but lacks high-visibility safety features and suffers from sightline obstructions due to parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using continental or ladder patterns to increase visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians further into the street before they cross.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.
